source_text: A subset of ethicists critiques the nomenclature disparity with male genital cutting, positing gender bias in ethical framing—male procedures are normalized as "circumcision" despite non-consensual infant application, while FGM's all forms are pathologized—yet empirical comparisons reveal FGM's greater tissue loss (up to 80% in Type III) and zero net health gains, justifying the terminological distinction on harm-based grounds. [13] [14]
